executable.title: Ruler to Rectangle
executable.description: Convert each ruler to an image-axis-aligned VolView rectangle. Annotations travel as .annotations.json file parameters.

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Volume the annotations were placed on. Declared so the derived annotations come back onto this image; the transformation itself reads no pixels.

file.name: inputAnnotations
file.label: Input Annotations
file.description: Rulers, rectangles, and polygons placed on the input volume.

file.name: outputAnnotations
file.label: Output Annotations
file.description: One derived image-axis-aligned rectangle for each input ruler.

parameters.label: Girder API
parameters.description: Server access injected by slicer_cli_web; not shown to users.
